categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction broadcasting behavior and configuration options.
categories.rationale: Prevents transaction origin leakage by allowing users to disable periodic unconfirmed transaction rebroadcasts independently of initial broadcasting, defaulting to off. As noted in the description, 'Rebroadcasting transactions that are already known to the network reveals that the wallet is related to them,' fixing a known network privacy concern for wallet transactions.
